Her true strength lies in assaults like a sudden gale. She is ill suited to holding ground.

Archer should already have defeated her and reached Sakura.

The fact that he hasn't——could Rider actually be pushing him back…?

pages.en:
——In that instant, everything congeals.

Rider's naked eyes.

Among the many varieties of Mystic Eyes, these belong to the highest order: inhuman eyes in the fullest sense.

“————”

Gray eyes.

They resemble works fashioned from crystal, too alien to be called human organs.

Corneas that hold no light.

Rectangular pupils opening upon the outer world.

Their irises lie frozen, forbidding the eyes to close.

Every one of the hundred million retinal cells that carry visual information is formed from ether, the Sixth Imaginary Element.

——A work of art cherished by the gods, or an inborn gift they envied enough to curse.

Rider's gray eyes are strange beyond measure and, at the same time, far too beautiful for any human to possess.

“——!”

Archer has frozen.

…Did he meet Rider's eyes directly at that distance?

It is already too late to close his own; his eyelids have turned rigid. The arm he might raise to cover his face will not move.

He tries to advance and strike Rider down, but both legs have already turned to stone up to the knees.

My eyes have been caught by Rider's Mystic Eyes as well. I cannot look away.

My blood begins to harden.

A single-action working of magecraft possessed by a mage.

They transform the eye——ordinarily a passive organ that receives information from the world——into an active instrument that imposes itself upon the world.

In plain terms, they impose magecraft indiscriminately upon everything in their wielder's field of vision. If a target looks back into the Mystic Eyes, their power increases dramatically.

They are things one must not see: a terrifying magical trait that ensnares its victim through the mere act of looking.

The technique of remaking one's eyes into Magic Circuits resembles the method by which a Magic Crest is formed.

The bearers of truly powerful Mystic Eyes invariably possessed them from birth.
